# LLM Eval Suite

> Local point-and-click test and evaluation for language models, for teams who run the model on a machine they control. Built by AI Eval Corp.

The app is a FastAPI process on 127.0.0.1:8765, started with run_app.bat on Windows or `python -m llm_eval_suite.app`. It connects to Ollama, an OpenAI-compatible server, or a local Hugging Face folder, including a nanoGPT checkpoint converted to GPT-2 with a logits check. Presets are Quick, Standard, Full, and Government T&E. A run can compare two models, print an HTML report, summarize with local judges, and run live garak. Pass rate is 1 minus garak's attack success rate. Empty garak generations are marked INVALID instead of scored as real replies. A 6 October 2026 comparison on a Windows test PC found that a Department of War news fine-tune did not improve factuality over base gpt2-medium.
